title: Manifest merge by record
description: Field report 14 (dbEmbed portal): every writer appends at a list tail, so branches that add different records conflict on the same lines. Ship a record-level git merge driver with an install verb, a shim under the git common dir that falls back to markers when the plugin root moved, and a doctor check.
desiredOutcome: Two branches that each add a phase, task, bug or fileIndex row merge the manifest with no conflict once the driver is installed, in both layouts and both merge directions with identical bytes; a real conflict is shown as only the records that disagree.
summary: Every task of this phase finished before a phase's status was derived. It was closed afterwards, when phase sign-off became a recorded verdict (P63), and no sign-off review ran at that close - so the verdict is skipped, and what this phase did is recorded by its tasks' commits and outcomes, not attested here.

tasks.title: Record-level three-way merge of a manifest document
tasks.description: Pure merge3(base, ours, theirs): records matched by id, fileIndex rows as sets, same-id-added-twice and same-field conflicts reported, symmetric deterministic order, conflict-marker rendering of only the disagreeing records.

outcome.technical: _manifest_merge.merge3 matches keyed lists by id, fileIndex rows as sets, symmetric order; render diffs the two whole resolutions.
outcome.descriptive: Two branches that each add a different record merge by id instead of conflicting on shared lines; only real disagreements remain, as marker blocks.

tasks.title: merge-manifest.py: the git merge driver, its install verb and the stale-root shim
tasks.description: Driver for %O %A %B %P: revalidate a merged single-file plan (only NEW findings fail), fall back to git merge-file markers on unreadable input or internal error, exit only 0/1. install|uninstall|status writes .gitattributes, local git config and a POSIX-sh shim under the git common dir.

outcome.technical: merge-manifest.py driver/install/uninstall/status; revalidates single-file merges on new findings only; empty %O handled; shim under the git common dir.
outcome.descriptive: git merges the manifest through the driver; every failure path leaves markers, never ours alone.

tasks.title: Document the merge driver and scope the no-conflict promises
tasks.description: layout.md merge-driver subcommand, README team section, COMPATIBILITY promise for the driver name, CHANGELOG, dated status note in the concurrency report.

outcome.technical: layout.md merge-driver section, README, COMPATIBILITY, CHANGELOG, orchestrator.md, dated note in the concurrency report.
outcome.descriptive: The driver is documented and the no-conflict promise is scoped to a phase run.

tasks.title: Doctor: driver installed per clone, and the shim still points at a real plugin root
tasks.description: WARNING when .gitattributes names the driver and this clone has none configured, or when the shim's recorded root no longer exists.

outcome.descriptive: The doctor says whether this clone merges the manifest by record, and warns when the team's attributes and this clone disagree.

tasks.title: _merge_install.py: the install's pieces named once, for the verb and the doctor
tasks.description: The doctor (layer 4) may not load an entry point, so what an install consists of and how to read it back moves to an L1 module both import - one reading, not two.

outcome.technical: _merge_install at L1; sh_quote/sh_unquote pair fixes a quoted plugin root.
outcome.descriptive: The install's pieces are named once and read back identically by status and the doctor.
